lss.config.receive_server_lods.tooltip: Whether to receive LOD chunk data from the server. Disabling this stops all LOD networking.
lss.config.lod_distance.tooltip: Maximum LOD distance in chunks. Set to 0 to use the server's configured distance.
lss.config.column_rate_limit.tooltip: Caps how many LOD columns per second the server streams to you. Lower this if receiving LODs stutters your game or saturates your connection. Automatic backpressure still applies on top. Set to 0 for unlimited.
